  for (const allowedUrl of redirectAllowlist) {
    allowed = allowed || url.includes(allowedUrl)
  }
  return allowed
}

  redis:
    image: redis:7.4.4-alpine
    container_name: juice-shop-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--maxmemory", "128mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    expose:
      - "6379"
    networks:
      - juice-shop-net

  mongo:
    image: mongo:8.0.0
    container_name: juice-shop-mongo
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mongosh", "--eval", "db.adminCommand('ping')"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
    environment:
      MONGO_INITDB_DATABASE: juiceshop
    expose:
      - "27017"
    volumes:
      - mongo-data:/data/db
    networks:
      - juice-shop-net

volumes:
  juice-shop-data:
    driver: local
  mongo-data:
    driver: local

networks:
  juice-shop-net:
    driver: bridge
